dishes.name: Bergamotes de Nancy
dishes.desc: Amber hard candies flavoured with bergamot oil, individually hand-wrapped. They hold a PGI, and only a handful of makers, several in Nancy, may produce them.

dishes.name: Macarons de Nancy
dishes.desc: Almond-heavy macarons with a crisp top and soft centre, unlike the filled Parisian kind. The recipe goes back to nuns in Nancy at the time of the French Revolution.

dishes.name: Baba au rhum
dishes.desc: Soft yeast cake soaked in rum syrup, born in the court of Duke Stanislas, who first used Hungarian tokaji wine. One of three Lorraine specialities from the Enlightenment era.

dishes.name: Pâté lorrain
dishes.desc: Marinated pork and veal, soaked in white wine and herbs, baked in a golden puff-pastry case. Best eaten warm; found in Nancy's bakeries and delis.

dishes.name: Bilberry tart
dishes.desc: Tart of wild bilberries picked in the Vosges mountains, one of the Vosges' regional pastries. The berries also go into jam and sweets.
